newsitem.title: ITALY: ATHLETICS-MOURIT TO MAKE BELGIAN DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MOURIT TO MAKE BELGIAN DEBUT.

text.p: Former Moroccan champion Mohamed Mourit will make his debut in a Belgian vest at the world cross country championships on Sunday.

Mourit, who hopes to become the first Belgian man to make the top 10 of the event since 1981, heard on Monday that he had been cleared by the International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF) to compete for his adopted country.
Mourit, who has lived in Belgium for six years and is married to a Belgian, had originally hoped to make his debut for his new country at the European championships in Belgium last December.
Earlier this month, he won the Lisbon half marathon, beating Italy's world champion Stefano Baldini.
